investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumlane Trips (travel booking); Platform: AWS sa-east-1 (zones sa-east-1a/sa-east-1b/sa-east-1c); network range 10.52.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster lumlan-prod-saeast (EKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic checkin-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer checkin-api, consumer ancillaries-svc; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
